name: browser_navigate
blocked: Navigation/history/load failure and stop; fresh identity after commit; no retry after uncertain load.

name: browser_snapshot
blocked: Isolated DOM refs, visibility, iframe/open-shadow coverage, budgets and loading observations. Result fixture is viewport-shaped; not a full-snapshot oracle.

name: browser_click
blocked: Covered/moved/stale target prevents input; pointer-delay cancellation; final click may navigate, earlier click may not continue.

name: browser_type
blocked: Focused/ref input, clear/append/empty delete and submit ordering; no insertion/Enter after cancellation or intermediate navigation.

name: browser_select
blocked: SELECT text/value matching and input/change dispatch; no option/non-select errors; Chose note. Generic fixture is only envelope coverage.

name: browser_press
blocked: Key aliases/modifiers, clamp/round repeat count, release ordering and navigation barrier between repetitions.

name: browser_scroll
blocked: Ref reveal or viewport wheel, amount clamps, stale-page cancellation and new observation identity.

name: browser_screenshot
blocked: Actual pixel capture, four-screen crop, 1280-width resize, JPEG quality 82 and coordinate scale; payload fixture is NOT a JPEG.

name: browser_read
blocked: Bounded live HTML capture, frozen readId invalidation and native HTML parser/converter; UTF-16 slicing must not become UTF-8 byte offsets.

name: browser_wait
blocked: Cancellable polling, open-shadow search, wait_timeout versus success, settle and no continuation after deadline.

name: browser_tabs
blocked: Real tab owner: list/new/switch/close, receipt pinning, no eviction at 12, late readiness cannot navigate after abort.
